wayland_display.description: The name of the Wayland server display socket.

xwayland_no_glamor.description: Disable glamor and DRI3 support in Xwayland, for testing purposes.

xwayland_args.description: List of additional command line arguments to pass to Xwayland (e.g., ['-rootless', '-verbose']). Must correspond to real documented settings like -rootless, -verbose, -glamor, etc. If empty, no args are added.
